blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ خُبَيْبٍ ﵁ اَنَّهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ الله ﷺ: قُلْ، فَلَمْ اَقُلْ شَئْيًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: قُلْ، فَلَمْ اَقُلْ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: قُلْ، فَقُلْتُ: مَا اَقُوْلُ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ اَحَدٌ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ، حِيْنَ تُمْسِيْ وَحِيْنَ تُصْبِحُ، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، تَكْفِيْكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب ما يقول اذا اصبح، رقم:٥٠٨٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Hazrat Abdullah ibn Khubaib (RA) says, the Prophet ﷺ said to me, “Say!” I remained silent. Again he said, “Say!”, and I remained silent. The third time he again commanded, “Say!' I asked, “O Rasulullah! What shall I say?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “Recite “Qul huwallahu ahad”, “Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq” and “Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas” three times morning and evening! These surahs will protect you from every harm that causes hurt.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Some scholars explain this hadith as: “Those who are unable to recite much, if they at least keep reciting these three surahs morning and evening, insha'Allah this alone will be sufficient.'
(Sharh at-Tibi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَا عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ! اِنَّكَ لَنْ تَقْرَأَ سُوْرَةً اَحَبَّ اِلَي اللهِ، وَلَا اَبْلَغَ عِنْدَهُ، مِنْ اَنْ تَقْرَأَ (قُلْ اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَق۞) فَاِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ اَنْ لَا تَفُوْتَكَ فِيْ صَلَاةٍ فَافْعَلْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “O Uqbah ibn Amir! You cannot recite any surah more beloved to Allah and more quickly accepted by Him than Surah “Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq'. So, if you are able to recite it in Salah as much as you can, keep reciting it!” Hazrat
